notes: Question 2 (age/province distribution of active customers): their AGE_GROUP bucketing DATA step plus the two PROC SQL aggregations (active-customer count via COUNT(Actdt)-COUNT(Deactdt), summed Sales), run on 15 mock rows built to the script's Actdt/Deactdt/Province/Sales shape. The original WHERE clause used a comma between two predicates (WHERE deactdt is null, province is not null), which is invalid SAS (confirmed against SAS 9.4 PROC SQL WHERE-clause syntax, and reproducing it against Jenner throws the same parse error real SAS would) -- corrected to AND. PROC GCHART pie-chart steps were left out since they render graphics rather than exercise data logic; the PRINT/SQL steps carry the same distributions.
